description_en: Sends a user message to a specified session or cancels a session
description_zh: 向指定会话发送用户消息或取消会话
name: SendChatMessage

parameters.help_en: [Optimized] This field is now automatically obtained by the backend. You do not need to specify this field when calling the API
parameters.help_zh: 【已优化】该字段已改为后台主动获取，调用API时无需填入
parameters.name: dms_unit

parameters.help_en:
The session ID. This is an optional field used for multi-turn sessions.
You can start a session without specifying this field. The response includes the SessionID of the current session.
You can also manually create a session ID by calling the CreateDataAgentSession operation and include the ID when initiating a session.
For multi-turn conversations (such as follow-up questions or confirming execution plans), specify the SessionID returned by the previous SendChatMessage call
parameters.help_zh:
会话 ID，选填字段，用于多轮会话
您可不填入该字段直接开始会话，响应里会包含本次会话的 SessionID
您也可以通过 CreateDataAgentSession接口手动创建会话ID，发起会话时携带该ID
若您需要多轮对话（如：追问、确认执行计划），请在该接口携带上一次SendChatMessage接口返回的SessionID
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: [Optimized] This field is now automatically obtained by the backend. You do not need to specify this field

parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: The message content to send to the Agent
parameters.help_zh: 本次向Agent发送的消息内容
parameters.name: message

parameters.help_en:
The message type. Default value: `[primary]`.  

For regular interactions with the Agent, set the message type to `[primary]`.

When the message is a response to the Agent's Human-in-Loop question, set the type to `[additional]`.

When the message is intended to trigger report generation, set the type to `[report]`.

When the message is intended to cancel the current session, set the type to `[cancel]`
parameters.help_zh:
消息类型，默认为 `[primary]`。  

常规情况下，和Agent交互，消息类型为 `[primary]`

当该消息为响应Agent的Human-in-Loop问题时，类型应当是`[additional]`

当该消息是要触发一次报告绘制时，类型应当是 `[report]`

当该消息是要取消当前会话时，类型应当是`[cancel]`
parameters.name: message_type

parameters.help_en:
Important

When this message is a reply to an Agent message (for example, the Agent asks a clarifying question through ASK_HUMAN), set reply_to to the exact Checkpoint sequence number carried in that Agent message. If this message is not a targeted reply, such as requesting the Agent to perform further in-depth analysis after analysis is complete, you can leave reply_to empty or set it to "0".  

This field affects how the Agent decides to process the message. Incorrect values may lead to analysis results that do not meet expectations
parameters.help_zh:
重要

当本消息是回复Agent消息（如：Agent通过 ASK_HUMAN进行问题澄清），则reply_to应当精确传入这条Agent消息携带的 Checkpoint 序号。若本消息无针对性的回复，如分析完成后要求Agent进一步深度分析，则 reply_to 可不填入或者填入"0"。  

该字段会影响Agent决策如何处理该消息，若传递错误可能导致分析效果不及预期
parameters.name: reply_to

parameters.help_en: The quoted content. This is typically used during interactions with the Agent
parameters.help_zh: 传入当前引用内容，通常在与Agent交互时使用
parameters.name: quoted_message

fields.help_en: The list of columns that are allowed for querying in the current table. If this field is left empty, all columns can be queried. If specified, SQL statements that exceed the allowed scope are blocked. For example, syntax such as SELECT * is blocked. To ensure DataAgent analysis effectiveness, avoid specifying columns beyond the allowed scope in the DataAgent prompts, knowledge, or instructions modules. Otherwise, unauthorized SQL statements may be generated and blocked, which reduces DataAgent analysis speed and effectiveness
fields.help_zh: 当前表允许查询的字段列表。若不填表示都可以查询。若填写，超过允许范围的SQL将会被禁止执行，如类似SELECT * 的语法将会被禁止。为了保证DataAgent分析效果，请注意DataAgent的提示词、知识、指示等模块尽量不要给出超过范围的字段，以免生成无权限SQL被禁止执行，导致降低DataAgent分析速度以及分析效果
fields.name: allowed_columns

fields.help_en:
The list of columns that are not allowed for querying in the current table. If this field is left empty, all columns can be queried. If specified, SQL statements that exceed the allowed scope are blocked. For example, syntax such as SELECT * is blocked.  

If both the disallowed list and the allowed list are configured, the disallowed list takes higher priority. For example, if Table 1 has columns A, B, C, and D, and columns A and B are configured as not queryable while columns B and C are configured as queryable, the final result is that only column C is queryable.

To ensure DataAgent analysis effectiveness, avoid specifying columns beyond the allowed scope in the DataAgent prompts, knowledge, or instructions modules. Otherwise, unauthorized SQL statements may be generated and blocked, which reduces DataAgent analysis speed and effectiveness
fields.help_zh:
当前表禁止查询的字段列表。若不填表示都可以查询。若填写，超过允许范围的 SQL 将会被禁止执行，如类似 SELECT * 的语法将会被禁止。  

如果同时配置了禁止列表和允许列表，禁止列表将以更高的优先级生效。如表1有列A、B、C、D，配置列A和列B不可查询，同时配置列B和列C可查询，则最终生效为列C可查询。

为了保证 DataAgent 分析效果，请注意 DataAgent 的提示词、知识、指示等模块尽量不要给出超过范围的字段，以免生成无权限 SQL 被禁止执行，导致降低 DataAgent 分析速度以及分析效果
fields.name: disallowed_columns

fields.help_en: The required row filter condition for the current table. If this field is left empty, it is ignored. If specified, all SQL statements involving this table are validated to check whether they carry the filter field and whether the WHERE condition meets the constraints. fields.help_en:
The default action for table-level permissions. This parameter controls whether tables that are not configured in DataSources.[item].Permission can be queried. Valid values: allow, deny.

allow (default): works in blacklist mode. By default, all tables can be queried, and the actual permissions are subject to the permissions configured on the Data Management side. Row-level and column-level permissions are enforced only when you configure row-level and column-level permissions in DataSources.[item].Permission.

deny (must be manually specified): works in whitelist mode. By default, no tables can be queried. A table can be queried only when you configure permissions for it in DataSources.[item].Permission. You can grant full access to a table by not configuring any row-level or column-level restrictions
fields.help_zh:
表级别权限默认行为。用于控制未在 DataSources.[item].Permission里配置的表能否查询。该字段目前支持[allow, deny] 两个枚举值。

allow（默认），表示以黑名单模式工作。默认所有表均可执行查询，实际权限以在DMS侧配置的权限为准。仅当您在DataSources.[item].Permission里配置了行列级权限时，会以行列级权限进行管控。

deny（需手动传入），表示以白名单模式工作。默认所有表均不可执行查询。仅当您在DataSources.[item].Permission里配置了某个表的权限（您可以通过不配置任何行列级限制来实现对某个表的完全授权），才可以执行查询
